_comment: Bench conveyor rig limits (2026-08-05). THE MANIPULATED VARIABLE IS NOW VOLTAGE, not a speed setpoint: the rig is open loop and the PLC command register drives motor voltage (see mpc_contract.md). u bounds therefore span 0 V to the measured 24.8 V supply rail, where the command register saturates. The previous values (u_max 660) were RPM and became meaningless the moment the plant input changed.
_du_derivation: du = +/-1.273 V/tick preserves the previous physical smoothness: 50 RPM/tick / 39.2742 RPM-per-V = 1.273 V/tick at dt = 1 s.
_I_max_derivation: Soft limit on current_lp15_a. Observed p99 = 0.0544 A, hard safety limit max_safe_current_a = 0.15 A, so 0.10 A sits above normal operation and below the hard backstop. The old 0.25 A was set for a rig drawing 10x this current and could never bind.
